svg.title: Nightly Mode -- AI grading deferred to a triggered rerun

g.text: Nightly Mode -- AI grading deferred to a triggered rerun
Phase 1: on submission -- tests only, mark the work
grading_mode is NIGHTLY, so the AI component
is NOT invoked. The PENDING grading_task rows
are the marks the nightly rerun will look for.
This is the only fragile step in the whole
design. Gradescope has no public API, so it
is UI automation and WILL break when they
reskin. Keep every selector in one file.
It is also a BULK action over the entire
assignment, which is why phase 3 must skip
Phase 3: the rerun -- AI grading for marked targets only
Already graded on a previous night. Skip the
AI component entirely and re-emit the stored
feedback. Without this branch, every nightly
bulk rerun re-bills every submission in the
Minimum rules to ratify before A and C write
1. A failed task goes to FAILED and increments
attempt_count. The next night retries it
2. LLM calls retry with backoff on 429 and 5xx
3. A claimed task that never completes must
time out back to PENDING, or a crashed
container strands it in IN_PROGRESS forever.
